test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a feature of public goods?

options.text: These goods are limited in supply.
Consumption of one person does not affect the consumption of another person.
Only tax payers can get the benefit of public goods.

solution:
The correct answer is **__Consumption of one person does not affect the consumption of another person__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **public good** is a good that is **non-excludable** and **non-rivalrous**.
 
• **Non-rivalrous** means the goods that do not diminish
